{{Quote|We have a mission for you, Captain Solo. Something that I feel is perfectly suited for someone with your particular... skills. We have an errand for you to run to Vergesso.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="EaW" />}}
The '''Scanning in the Vergesso Asteroids''' was a minor skirmish during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The captured pirate has divulged information he's gathered on this superweapon project. We know where Tarkin was conducting research, but we risk a frontal assault on a fortified Imperial station.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="EaW" />}}
In order to retrieve more information about the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|new Imperial superweapon]], the Alliance decided to attack one of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Tarkin's]] research facilities.

The station in question was heavily defended, so [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was tasked with infiltrating an Imperial cargo facility in the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]] and attaching an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|EMP]] device to a container bound for Tarkin's station.

==The mission==
{{Quote|You're going to find a particular cargo container that is destined for an Imperial research facility, and place a device in it.''"<br />"''This device wouldn't be of the explosive persuasion, would it?|Mon Mothma and Han Solo|<ref name="EaW" />}}
Han Solo and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] used the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to scan the system. Their intention was to find a container that would be heading to Tarkin's research station.

At some point [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], in the [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], arrived in the system searching for Solo but the ''Falcon'' managed to escape him.

After destroying some [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] on patrol, Han found the container and succeeded in placing the EMP device and left the system before any more Imperial reinforcements arrived.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We've been tracking the cargo container, and the Empire has finally delivered it to the station at Corulag. The EMP device we've planted will be discovered soon, so time is critical. Hurry to Corulag and detonate the device. With the station's defenses taken offline, we can move in and raid the facility for information.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="EaW" />}}
After the ''Millennium Falcon'' left the system, the container and its new load was sent to Tarkin's research facility, in orbit of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. A Rebel fleet was quickly assembled to [[Raid over Corulag|raid]] the station.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was the eighth mission of the Rebel campaign in the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''.
